summary: Iteration 2 — LocalLoop new-features round. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covering PATCH /api/profile + /auth/me reflect, chat 403-without-checkin + 200-after-checkin, stories require-checkin + ~24h expires_at, participants count+list, full crews flow (create, list, get, join by invite, custom+event suggestions, vote toggle, order-by-vote_count), and 401s for all authed endpoints. Original suite (/app/backend/tests/test_localloop_api.py) still 14/14. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, Expo web preview): demo-login -> map-home renders 8 emoji pins (map-pin-<id>), Surprise Me opens the event sheet, checkin toggles state, add-story-button appears after checkin, open-chat-button navigates to chat-screen, chat-input + chat-send round-trips a message into chat-messages, profile-screen saves name/bio/instagram (verified after re-open), crews-screen -> create-crew -> crew-detail-screen shows crew-invite-code, add-custom-suggestion + vote-<id> toggle works, suggest-event-button -> pick-event-<id> adds a map-event suggestion. Add Event: TimeWheel testIDs (wheel-hour/wheel-minute/wheel-period) present; submit-event creates event (verified via /api/events). Only non-blocking finding: TimeWheel is a native RN ScrollView with snap and onMomentumScrollEnd — Playwright mouse.wheel does not trigger onMomentumScrollEnd on RN Web, so programmatic wheel selection can't easily be automated on web (works fine on touch); default time still submits correctly and event persists.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking. Reference: TimeWheel.tsx:88 uses pointerEvents='none' as a prop; various StyleSheet blocks still use shadowColor/shadowOpacity.

Console error 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19'. Coming from a library (likely @gorhom/bottom-sheet or react-native-reanimated). Non-blocking but should be tracked; ensure deps are on React-19-compatible versions.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow and move pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents (TimeWheel.tsx and any other components).
(Nice-to-have) Audit library versions for the React-19 element.ref warning (likely bottom-sheet/reanimated).

(Optional) For automated web testing of TimeWheel, consider exposing an onValueChange trigger or aria value that Playwright can drive without onMomentumScrollEnd — current selection UX is fine on real mobile touch.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend responses cleanly exclude MongoDB _id in every new endpoint (profile, messages, stories, participants, crews).
require_attending() correctly gates messages + stories with 403; 401 is enforced by get_current_user Depends on all authed routes.
Story expires_at is set to now+24h in code (line 322) and TTL index is created (line 502) — verified expires_at delta ≈ 24.0h in tests.
Crews: create_crew auto-adds creator as member and includes them in initial votes on their own suggestions (vote_count=1, voted=True) — matches UX expectation.
Join by invite is idempotent ($addToSet) — matches note that both dev-sessions share the same user_id.
Suggestions correctly sorted by vote_count desc after each mutation.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL consistently; testIDs coverage is excellent across all new screens (profile, crews, crew/[id], chat/[eventId], TimeWheel, EventSheet Stories/Chat).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (12/12 feature areas verified end-to-end)
